_comment: Single source of truth for awesome-agent-motion-skills. Verified live on 2026-10-08 via GitHub API through HK proxy. Every entry represents an actionable Agent Skill for Coding Agents (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor).

skills.name: huashu-art-motion
skills.what: 35 curated artistic animation styles (Monet, Egyptian, Cyberpunk, 8-bit Mario, Ukiyo-e) and 9 spoken commentary animation grammars. Direct code generation without cloud GPU rendering.
skills.best_for: Topic explainer videos, artistic galleries, storybook narration, retro game animations
skills.prerequisites: None (runs purely in-browser & locally via agent-generated code)
skills.limitations: Audio-less output by default; voiceover must be synced separately.

skills.name: transitions.dev
skills.what: Curated library of 43+ production-grade UI transitions (morphing trays, page sweeps, micro-interactions, modal dissolves) designed specifically for AI agents to embed into web apps.
skills.best_for: SaaS dashboards, landing page interactive elements, native-feeling app screen transitions
skills.prerequisites: Node.js environment; Framer Motion or GSAP installed in target project
skills.limitations: Focuses strictly on UI state transitions, not full-length narrative videos.

skills.name: video-shotcraft
skills.what: Studio-grade cinematic video skill for Claude Code & Codex: 152 camera movement recipe cards and 209 motion previews. Generates complete code-driven Remotion video projects.
skills.best_for: Hardware/software product launch videos, promotional 3D teasers, cinematic sizzle reels
skills.prerequisites: Remotion environment; Chrome for server-side frame rendering
skills.limitations: Requires local render time via Remotion CLI; high CPU/GPU overhead during export.

skills.name: onetake
skills.what: Continuous-camera motion films that never cut between slides. Every beat dynamically morphs from the previous frame in a single uninterrupted spatial journey.
skills.best_for: Technical deep-dives, architecture pitch decks, investor presentations that flow continuously
skills.prerequisites: Modern browser supporting SVG morphing and Web Animations API
skills.limitations: Requires strict script structuring; hard cuts are disallowed by design.

skills.name: video-talkcraft
skills.what: Turns coding agents into a full motion-design studio for voiceover-driven explainers with word-level phonetic subtitle syncing, kinetic typography, and B-roll callouts.
skills.best_for: Educational tutorials, YouTube/Bilibili tech breakdown videos, documentation explainers
skills.prerequisites: Audio file or TTS provider key (OpenAI/ElevenLabs); Remotion CLI
skills.limitations: Heavy dependency on precise word-level audio alignment.

skills.name: motion-design-skill
skills.what: Adapts Disney's 12 basic principles of animation (anticipation, squash & stretch, follow-through) and physics-based spring curves specifically into prompts and rules for AI agents.
skills.best_for: Ensuring agent-generated web animations don't look robotic; organic icon & button physics
skills.prerequisites: Lottie web player or native CSS animations
skills.limitations: Provides principles and curve definitions rather than full pre-built video templates.

skills.name: motionmaxxing
skills.what: Agent skill focused on elevating AI-generated motion graphics: fixes pacing, adjusts spring dampening, eliminates jarring jump-cuts, and injects professional easing curves.
skills.best_for: Second-pass audit and aesthetic upgrade for raw animations generated by LLMs
skills.prerequisites: Compatible with any web animation framework (GSAP/CSS/Remotion)
skills.limitations: Designed as an optimization pass; does not generate initial compositions from scratch.
